_note: One NEW SCENE block per building, spliced into _prompt-template.txt by make-prompt.mjs. Designed fresh from Docs/features/buildings.md — what the building DOES decides what it looks like. Every one shares the kingdom's palette: warm cream stone, timber framing, blue tiled roofs, gold accents.
Townhall:
A single building, alone, centred: the TOWNHALL AT LEVEL 1 of a fantasy kingdom — the humble first hall a settlement starts from, and the seed of the castle in the reference image.

One modest hall of warm cream stone with timber framing, a steep BLUE tiled roof, and a single short square turret rising just above the roofline on the left, capped with its own small blue conical roof. A round-topped wooden double door in the centre of the front face, with two small windows either side. One narrow BLUE banner with a GOLD fleur-de-lis hangs beside the door. A low cream stone wall, knee-high, traces the edge of the building's square plot. A few small rounded bushes sit against the walls, and a short tidy path of warm earth leads to the door.

It must read as the SAME BUILDING that later becomes the reference image's castle — same cream stone, same blue roofs, same blue-and-gold heraldry — only small, plain and early. Modest, not ruined: no scaffolding, no damage, no cracks.
Housing:
A single small COTTAGE, alone, centred — a house for the kingdom's residents.

Warm cream stone walls with dark timber framing, a steep BLUE tiled roof, and a cream stone chimney with a soft wisp of smoke. A round-topped wooden door, two small windows with warm light inside, and a window box of small flowers. A couple of rounded bushes against the wall and a tiny patch of warm earth at the door. Modest, tidy and lived-in.
Farm:
A single small FARM BARN, alone, centred — the building whose crew works the crop plots nearby.

A compact barn of cream stone below and warm timber boards above, with a steep BLUE tiled roof and wide double barn doors standing open. Two round hay bales and a small wooden handcart beside it. A short fence of timber rails on one side. No fields and no crops — only the barn and its yard.
Sawmill:
A single small SAWMILL, alone, centred — the building whose crew works the forests nearby into Wood.

An open-sided timber shed under a steep BLUE tiled roof, with a large upright circular saw blade of pale steel mounted on a bench inside, clearly visible. A neat stack of cut logs on one side and a scatter of pale wood shavings on the ground. Cream stone footings under the timber posts.
Quarry:
A single small QUARRY YARD, alone, centred — the building whose crew works the mountains nearby for rock and metal.

A low cream stone workhouse with a BLUE tiled lean-to roof, beside a small cut face of grey rock with visible chisel steps. A simple wooden derrick crane with a rope and hook leans over it. Three dressed stone blocks stacked nearby and a wheelbarrow. Sturdy and dusty, not ruined.
Docks:
A single small DOCK, alone, centred — a pier where the kingdom's boats put out to the fishing shoals.

A timber pier on stilts running along the plot, with a small cream stone and timber hut under a BLUE tiled roof at one end. A wooden rowing boat moored alongside, a coil of rope, a stack of fish crates and a lantern on a post. The pier's planks and posts are clearly drawn. No water and no sea — only the pier and the hut.
Sanctum:
A single small SANCTUM, alone, centred — the building that holds and renews the kingdom's Mana.

A slender round tower of pale cream stone with a steep conical BLUE roof and a gold finial. An arched doorway and narrow arched windows. Floating just above the roof's point, a faceted crystal glowing soft VIOLET, with a few small motes of violet light drifting around it. The violet glow spills faintly onto the stone. Serene and magical.
Barracks:
A single small BARRACKS, alone, centred — the hall that raises the kingdom's soldiers.

A squat, sturdy hall of cream stone with a low BLUE tiled roof and small high windows. A short crenellated parapet along one side. A wooden weapon rack of spears and round shields stands against the wall, and one narrow BLUE banner with a GOLD fleur-de-lis hangs by the door. Solid and military, not decorative.
SpearHall:
A single small SPEAR HALL, alone, centred — the training hall for the kingdom's lancers.

An open-fronted timber training hall on cream stone footings, under a BLUE tiled roof, with its front open to show the inside. A tall rack of long spears stands within, and a straw training dummy on a post stands in the yard before it. A round shield leans against a post. Spare and practical.
ShootingGrounds:
A single small ARCHERY RANGE, alone, centred — where the kingdom's archers train.

A covered shooting line: a long low timber shelter on cream stone footings with a BLUE tiled roof, open at the front, with a rack of bows and a quiver of arrows inside. Facing it across the plot, one round straw target butt on a wooden stand with concentric rings, a few arrows in it. Trodden earth between them.
Stables:
A single small STABLES, alone, centred — where the kingdom's cavalry horses are kept.

A timber stable block on cream stone footings under a BLUE tiled roof, with two split stable doors, the upper halves open. A hay net and a water trough beside the door, a bale of straw, and a short paddock fence of timber rails on one side. No horses.
Infirmary:
A single small INFIRMARY, alone, centred — where wounded soldiers recover.

A calm cottage of cream stone with a BLUE tiled roof and a pale cream awning stretched on poles over the doorway. Through the open door, the end of a neat bed with white linen is visible. Terracotta pots of green herbs line the wall, and a small water basin stands by the step. Quiet and clean.

NO RED CROSS anywhere - not on the awning, not on a banner, not on a sign. The red cross is a protected emblem and must never appear. What says 'healing' here is the herbs, the clean linen and the water basin, nothing more.
Carpenter:
A single small CARPENTER'S WORKSHOP, alone, centred — where the crew works Wood into Planks.

A timber workshop on cream stone footings under a BLUE tiled roof, its wide front open. A sturdy sawhorse with a half-cut plank across it stands in front, a hand saw resting on it. A neat stack of finished pale planks beside it and curls of wood shaving on the ground. A mallet and chisels on a bench.
MasonsYard:
A single small MASON'S YARD, alone, centred — where the crew dresses Stone into blocks.

An open working yard with a low cream stone shed under a BLUE tiled lean-to roof. In the yard, a heavy timber workbench holding a half-dressed stone block, with a mallet and a broad chisel on it. Three finished square blocks stacked neatly, and a fine pale dust on the ground around them.
Smelter:
A single small SMELTER, alone, centred — where the crew smelts ore into Iron.

A thick stone furnace, squat and rounded, with a tall cream stone chimney and a small BLUE tiled roof over the working side. The furnace mouth glows warm ORANGE, with a soft orange light spilling onto the ground and a thin wisp of smoke from the chimney. A pair of bellows on a frame, and four dark iron ingots stacked beside it.
RuneCarver:
A single small RUNE CARVER'S SHED, alone, centred — where the crew pours Mana into cut stone.

An open timber shed on cream stone footings under a BLUE tiled roof. Standing in front of it, a waist-high upright slab of pale stone, half-carved, its grooves glowing soft VIOLET, with a few violet motes drifting up from it. A chisel and a mallet on a low bench, and one finished glowing runestone leaning against the shed.
Garden:
A single small ORNAMENTAL GARDEN, alone, centred — a decoration that makes the city pleasant.

A tidy little garden: low clipped green hedges forming a neat border, beds of small bright flowers in warm yellows, whites and soft pinks, a narrow path of pale gravel through the middle, and one small timber bench with a cream stone base. A slender ornamental tree with a rounded canopy in one corner. No building.
Well:
A single small WELL, alone, centred — a decoration that makes the city pleasant.

A round well of warm cream stone, waist high, with a small steep BLUE tiled roof on two timber posts above it, a wooden windlass with a rope, and an oak bucket hanging from it. A few rounded cobbles and small green plants at its foot, and a pail set on the rim. Charming and simple. No building.
Orchard:
A small ORCHARD, alone, centred — a decoration that makes the city pleasant.

Six small fruit trees in two tidy rows, with rounded dense canopies and small red and gold fruit among the green leaves, each with a slim trunk. Neat green grass beneath them and a low timber rail fence around the whole plot, with a simple gate. A wooden ladder leaning against one tree and a basket of fruit on the ground. No building.
Statue:
A single small STATUE, alone, centred — a decoration that makes the city pleasant.

A pale cream stone statue of a robed figure standing calmly with one hand raised, mounted on a square stepped plinth of the same stone, with a band of GOLD trim around the plinth. Small clipped green shrubs at the base of the plinth and a ring of pale paving stones around it. Dignified and modest in size. No building.
Plaza:
A small town PLAZA, alone, centred — a decoration that makes the city pleasant.

A paved square of pale cream flagstones laid in a pattern, with a round cream stone FOUNTAIN at its centre, clear cyan water arcing from it and filling the basin. Two timber benches with cream stone ends, two slender lamp posts with GOLD tops and warm glass, and four small clipped trees in square stone planters at the corners. Open and welcoming. No building.
Shrine:
A small SHRINE, alone, centred — a decoration that makes the city pleasant, and the most sacred of them.

An open-sided shrine on a low stepped platform of pale cream stone: four slender cream stone columns carrying a steep BLUE tiled canopy roof with a GOLD finial. Under it, a simple cream stone altar with a soft VIOLET glow above it and a few violet motes drifting up. Two narrow BLUE banners with GOLD fleur-de-lis hang from the outer columns, and clipped green shrubs stand at the foot of the steps.
